await (async(page)=>{await page.locator('[data-testid=sandbox-normal]').click();await page.locator('[data-testid=agents-catalog-search]').fill('catalog-fixture');await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('[data-testid=agents-catalog-card-grid]')?.children.length===12);const target=page.locator('.agent-selection-card__name-target').first();await target.evaluate(e=>{for(let a=e.parentElement;a&&a!==document.body;a=a.parentElement){a.dataset.edgeOriginalStyle=a.getAttribute('style')??'';a.style.setProperty('transform','none','important');a.style.setProperty('overflow','visible','important');}});const results=[];for(const edge of ['top-left','top-right','bottom-left','bottom-right']){await page.mouse.move(800,500);await page.getByRole('tooltip').waitFor({state:'hidden'});await target.evaluate((e,edge)=>{e.style.cssText='position:fixed;z-index:900;width:300px;height:24px;'+(edge.endsWith('left')?'left:2px;':'right:2px;')+(edge.startsWith('top')?'top:2px;':'bottom:2px;');},edge);const targetBox=await target.boundingBox();await target.hover();await page.getByRole('tooltip').waitFor();await page.waitForFunction(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('[role=tooltip]')?.getBoundingClientRect();return t&&t.left>=0&&t.top>=0&&t.right<=innerWidth&&t.bottom<=innerHeight;});const box=await page.getByRole('tooltip').boundingBox();results.push({edge,targetBox,box,text:await page.getByRole('tooltip').innerText()});await page.screenshot({path:'C:/repositories/CanDoItAll/codex/bundles/UI_AgentCatalog_01_Extraction_Sandbox_Bundle/proof/SB02/verified-tooltip-'+edge+'.jpg',type:'jpeg',quality:78});}await target.evaluate(e=>e.removeAttribute('style'));await page.evaluate(()=>document.querySelectorAll('[data-edge-original-style]').forEach(e=>{e.setAttribute('style',e.dataset.edgeOriginalStyle);delete e.dataset.edgeOriginalStyle;}));await page.mouse.move(800,120);return results;})(page);
